title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.


Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours


Communication : Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.


Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).


Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).


This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.


Responsibilities:


  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.


Required Skills:


  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with Azure AI services or Microsoft AI Foundry.
  • Strong experience designing API-driven integrations and distributed automation architectures.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise data platforms, with a preference for Databricks.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and production-ready AI automation solutions.


Preferred Skills:


  • Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-agent workflows or human-in-the-loop automation systems.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Key Responsibilities


  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Use AI tools (Nanobanana, Freepik AI, Magic Canva Studio) to generate engaging videos and simple animations for social media.
  • Editing videos and creating simple animations for social media use.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications


  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Experience working with video editing tools like Premiere, CapCut, and Canva.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, Claude, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:

  • 62 euros (aproximadamente 405 reais) por partida coberta, além de reembolso de despesas de viagem e ingressos

title: Analista de Suporte AMS
description:
Já pensou em fazer parte de uma empresa Great Place to Work com a melhor solução para comércio exterior do mercado? Confira agora as responsabilidades e os requisitos para a vaga.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Atender e apoiar clientes na utilização do sistema, garantindo uma experiência eficiente e clara;
  • Realizar gestão de chamados, assegurando priorização adequada e cumprimento de SLAs.
  • Investigar e solucionar dúvidas, erros e problemas relacionados ao uso do sistema;
  • Participar de reuniões e acompanhamentos periódicos com clientes;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas internas (desenvolvimento, QA, produto) para garantir a resolução eficiente dos chamados;
  • Documentar atendimentos e contribuir com a melhoria dos processos de suporte;
  • Executar testes de validação e regressão em novas versões do sistema;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e reportá-las de forma estruturada;
  • Abrir e acompanhar backlogs e bugs junto às áreas responsáveis.
  • Realizar configurações de rotinas e parametrizações do sistema conforme necessidade do cliente.
  • Ajustar relatórios e auxiliar usuários na correta utilização das funcionalidades.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Ensino superior (concluído ou em andamento) ou técnico nas áreas de, Comércio Exterior, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente, especialmente em ambiente técnico ou corporativo;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade analítica e habilidade para lidar com problemas de forma estruturada;



DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência prévia com suporte a software ou suporte AMS;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de despacho aduaneiro, incluindo rotinas de importação e exportação;
  • Conhecimentos em MySQL ou SQL Server para consultas e análises básicas;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de Comércio Exterior ou ERPs será um diferencial.




Acreditamos em construir juntos , com respeito, inovação, bem-estar e, acima de tudo, cuidado mútuo .


Benefícios pensados em você:

  • Cartão VR/VA – iFood Benefícios pra você se alimentar do seu jeitinho;
  • Cartão Cultura – também no iFood, ideal pra curtir aquele cinema no fim de semana;
  • Gympass – corpo em movimento, mente em equilíbrio ainda com a possibilidade de incluir quem você ama;
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed – qualidade com abrangência nacional;
  • Plano Odontológico Dental Uni – sorrisos bem cuidados;
  • Seguro de Vida – proteção para você e sua família;
  • Convênio com Farma SESI – descontos em medicamentos e serviços;
  • Parcerias Educacionais – descontos em instituições de ensino, como SESI São Paulo, UNESC e SATC;
  • Escolas de idiomas – parceria com Yazigi e Open English;
  • Televita – sessões de psicoterapias de forma gratuita;
  • Mente em foco - parceria com psicólogos da região;
  • Kit Maternidade/Paternidade cheio de carinho.


Detalhes que só o jeito Narwal tem:

  • Fruit Time – frutas fresquinhas todos os dias no nosso recife;
  • Café, chá e cookies sempre por perto;
  • Biblioteca Narwal – acervo físico e online pra você se inspirar;
  • Day Off de aniversário – comemore sua vida como merece;
  • Yoga Laboral – relaxa o corpo e clareia a mente;
  • Programa Eu Indico – indique talentos e ganhe por isso;
  • Café Narwal – nosso momento de alinhamento semanal com comes, bebes e muita sinergia;
  • Eu Inspiro Esse Lugar Incrível – reconhecimentos mensais, pois aqui você é parte essencial da nossa cultura.





Na Narwal você ajuda a construir o dia a dia de milhões de brasileiros através de uma solução inteligente para comex. Faça parte do nosso recife.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com sólidos conhecimentos em Cloud AWS , para atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de pipelines de dados em ambientes distribuídos e escaláveis.

O(a) profissional será responsável por projetar soluções de dados eficientes, garantindo qualidade, performance e governança, atuando em conjunto com times ágeis e multidisciplinares.

Atribuições:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de Engenharia de Dados em ambiente cloud (preferencialmente AWS).
  • Atuar na modelagem de dados relacional e não relacional.
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados SQL para ingestão, transformação e consulta de dados.
  • Implementar e manter Data Lakes utilizando serviços AWS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares seguindo metodologias ágeis.
  • Atuar em ambientes de plataformas distribuídas, garantindo escalabilidade e confiabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que precisamos que você tenha de conhecimento:

  • Experiência como Engenheiro(a) e arquitetura de Dados.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Cloud AWS.
  • Domínio de Python para Engenharia de Dados.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (relacional e não relacional).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL.
  • Vivência em Data Lake e pipelines de dado

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager in our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget . This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managing multiple projects or client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.g., Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning & Execution: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities.
  • Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site and remote/hybrid work environments .
  • Budget & Risk Management: Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively; implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.g., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs.
  • Quality Assurance & Delivery: Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.g., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs.
  • Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement: Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emerging industry trends (like AI integration in project management , DevSecOps , and new collaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Professional Knowledge: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding of IT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentals to effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices.
  • Project Management Skills: Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects using project management methodologies (Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes.
  • Leadership & Communication: Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinating cross-functional teams , managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

  • Advanced Knowledge: Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such as cloud computing projects, digital transformation , or AI-driven solutions is a plus.
  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment , managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background in network/security infrastructure projects or software development projects is advantageous.
  • Methodologies: Certifications or hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) or DevOps/DevSecOps practices.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managing multiple full project lifecycles , with at least several projects related to IT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure . Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential.

Certifications:

  • Project Management Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 (highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise.
  • Security/Technical Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) , Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) , or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance.
  • Agile/Other Certs: Additional certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or ITIL Foundation are beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Consultor Funcional SAP, Testes, Negócios
description:
CHAMADA ÚNICA – BOOTCAMP SAP CCS|PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO


Não perca a oportunidade de fazer parte de um Programa de Capacitação exclusivo para um processo de seleção do BOOTCAMP SAP CCS - Customer Care & Service.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.


Participação: Formação Custeada Integralmente


Se você atende aos requisitos mínimos, envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail:(Bootcamp SAP CCS)


Vagas limitadas! Não perca essa oportunidade única de transformar sua carreira!

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here .

title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here .

title: UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer
description:
UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer


About the Role

We are looking for a UX & Data-Driven Usability Designer to help improve the performance of a large-scale digital commerce platform. This role focuses on identifying friction in critical customer journeys and delivering usability improvements that directly impact conversion.


You will own the Usability workstream, partnering closely with product and analytics teams to analyze user behavior, uncover drop-off points, and design improvements across key transactional flows such as cart, checkout, and payment.


This role is ideal for a designer who combines strong UX thinking with analytical rigor and enjoys working in fast-moving consulting environments where rapid insights and quick wins are highly valued.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead usability analysis across critical customer journeys including product discovery, cart, checkout, and payment.
  • Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process.
  • Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns.
  • Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains.
  • Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience.
  • Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact.
  • Work within a fast-paced consulting team delivering iterative improvements across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design or product design
  • Strong experience with data-driven design approaches, including funnel analysis and conversion optimization
  • Ability to collaborate with product and analytics teams to interpret quantitative data and translate insights into UX improvements
  • Experience mapping end-to-end user journeys and identifying usability improvements
  • Proven experience redesigning transactional flows such as cart, checkout, or payment experiences
  • Strong problem-solving and research skills
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Comfort working in fast-paced consulting environments with tight delivery timelines


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with A/B testing frameworks and experimentation programs
  • Background designing for marketplace platforms or high-traffic e-commerce products
  • Experience in consulting or agency environments with frequent stakeholder presentations
  • Familiarity with qualitative usability testing methods, including user interviews and moderated testing


This role offers the opportunity to combine UX design and analytics to drive measurable improvements in customer experience and platform performance. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Product Owner Pleno (PO)
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Product Owner Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Produtos e que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto

  • Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
  • Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.


Discovery e validação de soluções

  • Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
  • Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
  • Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.


Gestão do produto e delivery

  • Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
  • Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.


Colaboração com o time

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
  • Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Product Owner Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Produtos e que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto

  • Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
  • Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.


Discovery e validação de soluções

  • Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
  • Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
  • Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.


Gestão do produto e delivery

  • Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
  • Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.


Colaboração com o time

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
  • Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Growth Business Development (Fresh Graduates | Brazil)
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects
  • Contact, negotiate, and close profitable deals with potential KOLs
  • Support KOL and design special campaigns to increase KOL trading volume
  • Build partnerships with KOLs or crypto projects, and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing KOL/clients


Requirements


  • Open to fresh graduates or part-time Business Development
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and passionate about achieving results
  • A good understanding of crypto markets is a plus
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese is essential


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
A Immunomatics é uma startup sediada em San Diego, Califórnia, com a missão de melhorar os desfechos dos transplantes de órgãos por meio da seleção otimizada de doadores assistida por inteligência artificial (IA).


A empresa busca contratar profissionais brasileiros com conhecimento avançado em arquiteturas de deep learning.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar, testar e validar modelos de IA para estratificação de risco.


O que buscamos

  • Pós-graduação em Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Matemática.
  • Publicação de artigos científicos envolvendo o uso de redes neurais.
  • Experiência em projetar e implementar novas arquiteturas de redes neurais ou em personalizar arquiteturas existentes (CNN, RNN, Autoencoders, Transformers, etc.) para melhorar o desempenho preditivo do modelo.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de métodos e ferramentas computacionais.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Bônus: Experiência em Bioinformática.

title: [Suporte] Analista de Suporte Técnico Pleno | Protheus
description:
Apoiar no suporte técnico do ERP Protheus em Regra de Negócio e Análises técnicas nos módulos Financeiro, Contabilidade Gerencial, Ativo Fixo e Planejamento e Controle Orçamentário.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar o atendimento aos clientes, por meio dos canais TOTVS, esclarecendo suas dúvidas sobre assuntos referentes ao sistema, registrando sugestões e incidentes;
  • Registrar, em sistema, a solicitação do cliente com todas as evidências (tickets abertos) de detalhamento necessárias para todos os impactados;
  • Triar os tickets abertos pelo cliente e reclassificá-los ou categorizá-los, quando necessário, pelo tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento;
  • Fornecer status das demandas em evolução, quando solicitado pelo cliente, por meio de canais de atendimento (telefônico, por e-mail, sistema);
  • Escalonar, para o próximo nível, as solicitações ou incidentes que não forem evoluídos, após o esgotamento das possibilidades de solução dentro do tempo estimado pela Coordenação da área;
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/metas da área;
  • Alertar a coordenação e atuar em potenciais riscos ou crises em clientes;
  • Manter atualizados FAQs/banco de conhecimento com as soluções definidas e repassadas aos clientes;
  • Apoiar nos processos de melhorias, detectando novas soluções, identificando problemas e questões relevantes;
  • Realização de consultorias de suporte ou técnicas aos clientes
  • Prestar o atendimento, por meio de canais de abertura de tickets, de acordo com o processo definido e visando ao atendimento e às metas estabelecidas;


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Conhecimento técnico e de negócio nos módulos Financeiro, Contabilidade Gerencial, Ativo Fixo e Planejamento e Controle Orçamentário (PCO);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados;
  • Linguagem de programação ADVPL;
  • Análise e depuração de código fonte;
  • Conhecimento na arquitetura, instalação e configuração do Protheus;

title: Desenvolvedor Java com AWS
description:
Cód. 58604


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Dev, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Java (backend): desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações Java , com boa base em integração, performance e serviços.
  • AWS (serviços obrigatórios): experiência comprovada com S3, Step Functions, Glue e Athena (desenho/uso em pipelines e orquestração).
  • Engenharia de dados/ETL na AWS: capacidade de estruturar pipelines de dados (ingestão, transformação e consulta), preferencialmente usando Glue + Athena com dados em S3 e orquestração via Step Functions .



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information , click here.

Role reports to:

DIR ASSOCIA PESQ E DESENV

Location:

Latin America, Brazil, Sao Paulo, Sao Jose dos Campos

Work Location:

Hybrid

What you will do

The Clinical Science team is responsible for leading the clinical strategy development behind our innovation projects that support the safety and efficacy of our scientific communications and claims, translating the science behind our products for consumers and healthcare professionals.You will lead de development of the clinical strategy for Latam Self Care (OTC drugs) projects with Brazil and Mexico as main countries. This includes defining strategies to support product safety and efficacy through a range of sources, including clinical previous data, scientific literature, analytical data, additional new clinical studies and/or biowaiver, according to Regulatory framework defined for the project. The Clinical Science Principal Scientist will also be responsible for executing the clinical strategy defined, which includes leading clinical data collection for product regulatory dossier in CTD (Common Technical Document) format. Key Responsibilities:
  • Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for a pool of new products development/ introduction and product maintenance (OTC drugs) in LATAM markets from R&D Clinical Science standpoint focused on Mexico and Brazil as main countries
  • Lead the development of clinical strategies for Self-Care (OTC drugs) products submission to Health Authorities in collaboration with cross-functional team (mainly Product development, Regulatory Affairs/CMC, Analytical, Medical Affairs, Clinical Pharmacology and Clinical Operations)

  • Write technical documents to support product registration according to quality and compliance policies and regulatory requirements and support appropriate answer to deficiency letters from Health Authorities on the dossiers submitted

title: Gerente de Loja | Casa Shopping Barra da Tijuca RJ
description:
Sobre a Zissou


A Zissou nasceu com o propósito de redefinir a relação das pessoas com o sono, unindo produtos inovadores e foco total na experiência. Tudo é pensado para transformar a rotina de quem escolhe a marca, com sensibilidade para entender as necessidades de cada cliente e transformar a conversa em uma oportunidade real de conexão e venda.


Sobre a vaga 


Procuramos um(a) Gerente de Loja para assumir a liderança da Zissou no Casa Shopping. Esta é a nossa primeira loja fora de São Paulo e representa um passo importante no nosso plano de expansão. Queremos alguém que construa essa história junto com a gente.


Você será responsável por coordenar toda a rotina da loja, incluindo os processos administrativos (ponto, escalas, folgas), condução da equipe e acompanhamento de indicadores. Também terá papel essencial no desenvolvimento do time, na excelência do atendimento e na performance comercial. 


Principais responsabilidades


  • Coordenar, acompanhar e orientar a equipe de vendas com foco em resultado e excelência no atendimento.
  • Realizar a gestão administrativa da loja: controle de ponto, escalas, folgas, horas extras e processos operacionais.
  • Gerenciar a operação como um todo: pessoas, produtos, processos, estoque , VM e performance.
  • Realizar o recrutamento e seleção de novos talentos da loja, junto ao time de RH.
  • Acompanhar metas, indicadores e resultados, buscando consistentemente a superação dos objetivos mensais.
  • Atuar como embaixador(a) da Zissou, garantindo que os valores da marca estejam presentes no dia a dia da operação.
  • Antecipar desejos e necessidades dos clientes, criando ações de impacto e conexão com o público.
  • Promover um ambiente positivo e colaborativo, valorizando o time e fortalecendo a Cultura Zissou.


Requisitos


  • Vivência com artigos de luxo ou de alto valor agregado.
  • Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento.
  • Habilidade em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipe.
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão com autonomia e responsabilidade.
  • Visão analítica para indicadores e performance comercial.
  • Facilidade com pacote Office e ferramentas do Google.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Flexibilidade de horário e disponibilidade. 


Diferenciais que contam pontos


  • Experiência comprovada como gerente ou líder no varejo (colchões, enxovais, móveis ou similares).
  • Vivência com CRM ou ativações locais.
  • Conhecimento em vendas consultivas e personalizadas.


Jornada e escala


  • Funcionamento da loja: das 10h às 20h, de segunda a domingo
  • Escala de trabalho: 6x1


Benefícios


  • Comissão sobre vendas (de acordo com política interna)
  • Assistência médica 100% custeada para titular
  • Assistência odontológica (opcional com valor subsidiado)
  • Vale-refeição via Flash (restaurantes ou mercados)
  • Vale-transporte via Flash (sem desconto em folha)
  • Seguro de vida
  • Total Pass
  • Empréstimo consignado
  • Consultoria financeira e jurídica (C4Life)
  • Plataforma de saúde (Clude)
  • Convênio com o Sesc
  • Desconto em produtos Zissou

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.

A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.

  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;

  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.

  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital
